Zero regressions against either baseline. model-checker --help was confirmed to list all four registered theories under --load_theory, drop jupyter from --save's choices, and use corrected 'No args = markdown and json' wording. All 8 plan phases are marked [COMPLETED] with fully checked checklists. The pre-existing summary file's Regression Verification section had asserted a result for the in-package suite run without that run ever having been executed -- this was corrected to report the actually-measured 1912-passed figure.
